milvus.search_supported_before: partial and latently broken -- missing run_id/metadata_filters/telemetry_filters kwargs would raise an unhandled TypeError if ever called with them
milvus.search_supported_after: partial but now fails clearly -- accepts the full common kwarg contract and raises an explicit ValueError naming exactly what it can't do (no run-scoped collection, no filter pushdown) instead of crashing with TypeError or silently searching the wrong data
milvus.still_not_reachable_via_http: unchanged -- milvus remains absent from VECTOR_BACKENDS/BACKEND_REGISTRY, so ENABLED_VECTOR_BACKENDS=milvus still fails Settings.validate() and POST /search still rejects backend=milvus before engine.search() is ever called. This phase did not add milvus to the enabled-backend governance path -- doing so was out of scope for a defect fix and remains a Phase 12/backend-benchmark decision, gated on real evidence per the plan (Sec.20: 'Milvus yalniz full production adapter sozlesmesi tamamlandiysa benchmarka dahil edilebilir').

numpy_exact.note: numpy_exact now accepts run_id and queries seg_ch_{dimension}_runs when provided, instead of always querying the base (non-run) table regardless of caller intent. This makes it usable as a correctness cross-check for the Phase 6 exact-candidate-rerank work against an active run, which it could not do before. It also now raises clearly if metadata_filters/telemetry_filters are passed without candidate_ids, instead of silently ignoring them and returning unfiltered results.
